reason: Despite the 'small refactor' subject, this PR spans core plan-cache plumbing across planner, expression, executor, optimize, session expression context, and ranger. Plan cache changes are high-blast-radius because they can silently alter plan reuse eligibility, expression evaluation assumptions, predicate/range derivation, and execution correctness. The breadth and centrality of touched files make it worth a focused deep review for Blocker/High regressions.
